payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results obtained by the model on various datasets, including WER percentages.

claims.text: The model achieved state-of-the-art results of 2.95% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean using a beam-search decoder.
The model achieved 3.86% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean using greedy decoding without a language model.
Competitive results were reported on the Wall Street Journal and Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
